# Dryland Floras Network <img src="figures/DFN_logo.png" align="right" width="120" />

The Dryland Floras Network aims to serve as a global platform connecting botanists, ecologists and other researchers working to understand the diversity, evolution and conservation of dryland floras worldwide, bringing together expertise from across arid deserts and semi-arid steppes, grasslands, savannas and woodlands.
The network’s goals are to:
Foster communication, collaboration, knowledge exchange and new research opportunities among scientists studying dryland floras across regions and disciplines.
Facilitate the sharing and integration of knowledge across the world’s diverse dryland systems.
Maintain a dynamic directory connecting researchers, institutions and expertise in dryland floras across continents.
Support outreach and collaborative initiatives that advance the study, understanding and conservation of dryland floras.

#### _1. `reflora_summary`: Summarizing REFLORA collections_

The following code can be used to extract a summary of all REFLORA-associated collections, including herbarium acronym, curator's email contact, number of records and a direct link to the original REFLORA Integrated Publishing Toolkit ([IPT](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/reflora)).\
```r
library(refloraR)

summary_df <- reflora_summary(verbose = TRUE,
                              save = TRUE,
                              dir = "reflora_summary")
```
\
By specifying a vector of herbarium acronyms, the user can extract a summary for just the specific herbarium collection.\

```r
summary_some_df <- reflora_summary(herbarium = c("ALCB", "RB", "HUEFS", "US", "K"),
                                   verbose = TRUE,
                                   save = TRUE,
                                   dir = "reflora_summary")
```
\
\

#### _2. `reflora_download`: Downloading REFLORA specimen records_

The following code can be used to download original specimen records in DwC-A format and associated metada for all REFLORA collections.\

```r
library(refloraR)

reflora_download(verbose = TRUE,
                 dir = "reflora_download")
```
\
By specifying a vector of herbarium acronyms, the user can download specimens records for just the specific herbarium collection.\

```r
reflora_download(herbarium = c("ALCB", "HUEFS", "RB", "US", "K"),
                 verbose = TRUE,
                 dir = "reflora_download")
```
\
\
